spans.s: दृशति॑ f. looking, sight.
दृशि f. seeing, power of sight, eye, poss. ˚मन्त्.

दृ॑शीक a. worth seeing, conspicuous;
 n. sight.

दृशीक॑ a. looking at (—˚);
 m. spectator.
दृशीका॑ f. sight, appearance.
दृशे॑न्य a. = दृ॑शीक.
दृषत्कण m. small stone, pebble.
दृष॑द् f. rock, large stone, esp. the nether mill-stone.

दृषदुपल n. sgl. du. & ˚ला॑ f. du. the nether and
the upper mill-stone.
दृषदोलूखल n. sgl. mill-stone and mortar.

दृष्टदोष a. having found out faults or being found out
as a fault.
दृष्टपूर्व a. seen before.
दृष्टमात्र a. only seen.*
दृष्ट॑वीर्य a. of proved strength.
दृष्टसार a. of proved strength.
दृष्टश्रुत a. seen and (or) heard.
दृष्टार्थ a. whose aim is apparent, also = prec. a.
दृष्टिक्षम a. worth seeing (lit. bearing the sight).

दृष्टिक्षेप m. glance, look (lit. the throwing about of
the eyes).
दृष्टिगोचर m. = दृग्गोचर.
दृष्टिपथ m. = दृक्पथ.
दृष्टिपात m. = दृक्पात.
दृष्टिपूत a. purified by the sight.
दृष्टिमन्त् a. having sight or insight.
दृष्टिराग m. expression of the eyes.*
दृष्टिविक्षेप m. = दृष्टिक्षेप.

दृष्टिसंभेद m. mutual glance (lit. mixing or
meeting of glances).*
